date_note: Ministry of Education notified the university 12 Nov; notice posted 13 Nov; Kyunghyang report 14 Nov is the date used.
title: Inje University says external attack on class-site servers leaked 24,011 records of students and staff
impact: 24,011 records identified so far; names, IDs, emails and phone numbers.
summary: Kyunghyang Shinmun reports Inje University learned from the Ministry of Education on 12 November that servers of a site used to run classes were attacked. It has identified 24,011 records so far: student and staff numbers, names, emails and mobile numbers. The university says passwords and national ID numbers were not included, and warns of voice-phishing.
plain: A South Korean university says hackers took contact details of about 24,000 records of students and staff.
exec: Contact details leaked from a university feed phishing; it shows education servers remain targets.
action: Inje students and staff should ignore unknown texts and attachments; the university should review exposed class-site servers.

validation.note: One article read in full in this run; figures as stated there.

review.note: Compared title, 12 Nov ministry notice, 24,011 records, data types, passwords and ID numbers excluded, severity 1 against Kyunghyang article
